title: Action Surge Bladesinger Smiter
source: d4: D&D Deep Dive (Video ID: dS8rrFCVSBc)
notes: Respec not modelled (uses the final split): Act 3 = Fighter 1 / Oath of the Crown Paladin 2 / Fighter 2 / Bladesinging Wizard 8
companion: Lae'zel, Gale, Tav
permanent_buffs: Act 1 Auntie Ethel's Hair DEX; Act 1 Awakened
caveats: On Honour Mode, Haste only grants 1 extra attack instead of a full Action (5 attacks on Action Surge turn instead of 7). Taking 2 Fighter and 2 Paladin caps spell slots at Level 5 (enough for 4d8 Shadow Blade, but no Level 6 spell slots). Creator does not prescribe a full fixed item list beyond showcased pieces.

title: Pure Two-Handed GWM Hexblade
source: d4: D&D Deep Dive (Video ID: dS8rrFCVSBc)

caveats: Polearm Master bonus action haft attack is bugged in BG3 and does not use Charisma from Bind Hexed Weapon or apply weapon elemental damage riders. You cannot maintain a separate Pact Weapon and Hexed Weapon simultaneously to dual-wield with Charisma. Elemental Weapon does not stack with Drakethroat Glaive's Draconic Elemental Weapon buff.

title: Camp Cleric Party Buffer
source: Casual Veteran Gamer (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BdK5SbRRF5E)
notes: Not a modelled damage spell: Light, Aid
companion: Gale, Hireling
caveats: Warding Bond transfers 50 percent of damage taken by the buffed ally to the camp Cleric; non-Gale camp casters can die in camp if they run out of HP, whereas Gale automatically heals himself in camp. Trickery Domain can be chosen instead of Life Domain if you want Seeming at Level 9 to trigger Githyanki racial equipment passives on non-Githyanki party members.
